items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Henry Dog was in the corner.

ctx.x: Oh, Lord Henry Dog. Henry Dog. Henry Dog was in the corner. I said, though, Henry Dog has been in the corner way in my time. And I don't know who Henry Dog ever played better. He's in the spot about this. Just using the man that couldn't get enough part.

Henry Dog. Henry Dog. By the way, we were talking last time about the changes in drumming. Have there been many changes in drumming that you can describe how it happened? The changes in how? Well, I mean, in late years, the way they play drums now with these modern bands is different. And I wouldn't play drums.
